period.aggregation: Equal-sample monthly means grouped by UTC product archive timestamps. No interpolation, climatology or direct observation dating.

layer: Near-surface product with nominal 15m coordinate; no inferred physical thickness.

geometry.gate_role: Fixed regional comparison gates, not physical current endpoints.
geometry.native_point_order: Westward from 240E to 130E; preserve all 331 vector-valued native points.
geometry.display_dateline_rule: Split only at the existing 180E native source vertex; duplicate -180/+180 display coordinate, not a measurement.

length.operator: Native supported connected westward core path with local vector alignment and deterministic dynamic programming.
length.metric: WGS84 geodesic sum over retained path vertices, km.
length.rounding: Preserve raw numerical length; about-km display rounds to nearest 100km.
length.qualification: Numerically qualified regional path only; physical current identity, whole-current endpoints and rank remain unresolved.

section_spans.operator: Connected negative zonal component at fixed meridians 137E, 180E and 220E, anchored to nominal 8-18N native paths.
section_spans.interpretation: Meridional numerical span, not a flow-normal paired-edge physical-current width.
section_spans.withholding: Retain the censored May 180E result as null with its reason.
section_spans.tracking: No section passes all full-year local mutual-overlap criteria; no annual physical-width range admitted.

sensitivity_quantities.native_product_core_path_length: Threshold, penalty and alignment choices; all native gates remain required.
sensitivity_quantities.native_supported_anchor_search_path_leng: All stride/phase choices require native supported witness paths; chord and native-witness lengths are separate quantities.
sensitivity_quantities.fixed_path_thinned_geodesic_representati: Representation-only vertex thinning on one fixed native path; no new field resolution or independent measurements.

missing_value_rule: Preserve null, failure reason and boundary contacts. Never plot a withheld result as zero.
physical_uncertainty: Unknown; parameter/window/anchor/thinning spreads are not confidence bounds or physical seasonal envelopes.

source_roles.source:liu-zhou-pacific-nec-2020: Context and window choice; not the numerical source or a reproduction of the paper.
source_roles.source:osw-pacific-nec-connected-product: Explicit OSW measurement operator and retained diagnostics.
